capacity_model: Solid of revolution of the visible body profile, with 3 cm radial walls and top/bottom lids; useful capacity floors 80% of interior volume to whole litres. Polygon facets approximate that surface; the collision box and tap are not storage volume.
provenance: Original procedural barrel geometry for Caelum Argenteum. Reuses the owned station wood/iron/brass textures and #470 mesh-to-sprite projection. No external assets.
